Gas customers are not listed for heat pumps. facts.program: DTE Energy home energy assessment and air sealing
facts.claim: Blower door pre-test rebate $50; air sealing that cuts leakage 10% earns $75, 20% earns $125, 40% earns $150. Electric customers heating with an air source heat pump or electric baseboard can get 50% of the cost of a comprehensive audit, air sealing and insulation, up to $5,000, if air sealing cuts leakage at least 10%.
facts.amount: $50 to $150, or up to $5,000 for electric heat
facts.eligibility: Single-family or multi-unit homes with fewer than five units, more than 24 months old, separate entrances and meters
facts.notes: Read 2026-10-06. The page does not state the assessment fee.

facts.claim: No-cost weatherization, heating system tune-up or replacement, high efficiency water heater, ENERGY STAR refrigerator and lighting for households at or below 250% of the federal poverty guidelines ($80,375 for a family of four on the page)
facts.eligibility: DTE customers at or below 250% of federal poverty guidelines, or in programs such as SNAP or WIC; account active and in good standing

facts.notes: Read 2026-10-06. Apply through a participating community organization in your county; phone (833) 627-2300.

facts.program: Ann Arbor A2ZERO home energy rebates
facts.claim: Cold climate heat pump $4,000 ($5,500 income-qualified); ductwork $1,500 ($2,500); heat pump water heater $1,000 ($2,000); electrical panel $1,000 ($2,000); battery storage $2,000 ($3,500); induction cooktop $500 ($750); heat pump dryer $300 ($500); insulation $500 per measure ($1,000); air sealing $500 ($1,000); rebates may not exceed 90% of project cost
facts.eligibility: Owners or renters of residential property in the City of Ann Arbor; income-qualified at or below 120% of area median income ($116,200 for one person, $166,000 for four); heat pump must be on ashp.neep.org with SEER2 15.2+ and HSPF2 8+; dual-fuel not eligible; Manual J and AHRI certificate required
facts.dates: Reserve funds first (up to 10 business days), finish within 90 days of approval, check in 6 to 8 weeks
facts.notes: Read 2026-10-06. Page says open for home energy rebates; the city set aside about $1.9 million from the 2022 Community Climate Action Millage, about half for income-qualified households. EV rebates are fully reserved with a waiting list (updated 8/17/2026).

facts.notes: Read 2026-10-06. Rates vary by lender and county.
